title: 刚买湖人就转手：沃尔特200亿关联贷款，司法部与SEC同时盯上？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Wall Street Finance here Mark Walter owns some of the most glamorous franchises and professional sports.
segments.zh: 华尔街财经，马克·沃尔特拥有多个顶级职业体育俱乐部。

segments.en: There is the dominant Los Angeles Dodgers.
segments.zh: 包括实力强劲的洛杉矶道奇队。

segments.en: Chelsea Football Club, F1 Cadillac Team, and even the entire professional women's hockey league,
segments.zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部、F1凯迪拉克车队，甚至整个职业女子冰球联盟，

segments.en: where the winner plays for the Walter Cup.
segments.zh: 冠军球队争夺沃尔特杯。

segments.en: So it sends shockwaves across sports and finance when Walter suddenly sold one of his crown jewels, the Los Angeles Lakers.
segments.zh: 因此，当沃尔特突然出售其核心资产之一——洛杉矶湖人队时，体育界和金融界都为之震动。

segments.en: It only bought the team in 2025.
segments.zh: 他在2025年才买下这支球队。

segments.en: To turn around and sell arguably the most glittering trophy in his cabinet, within a year was a complete shock.
segments.zh: 不到一年就转手卖掉堪称其最耀眼的奖杯，这完全令人震惊。

segments.en: What has emerged since is that federal prosecutors have been showing a deep interest in the world of Mark Walter
segments.zh: 此后浮现的情况是，联邦检察官对马克·沃尔特的世界表现出浓厚兴趣，

segments.en: and his sprawling business empire. What's happening is that the Justice Department and the Securities and Exchange Commission are investigating why two insurers' Walter controls
segments.zh: 以及他庞大的商业帝国。目前，司法部和美国证券交易委员会正在调查沃尔特控制的两家保险公司

segments.en: failed to properly disclose $20 billion in loans to affiliated businesses.
segments.zh: 为何未能适当披露向关联企业提供的200亿美元贷款。

segments.en: This story is all about Wall Street moving into a part of the market that was often seen as unsexy, dormant, and boring.
segments.zh: 这个故事讲的是华尔街进入了一个常被视为乏味、沉寂、无聊的市场领域。

segments.en: That is, insurance. This matters because for a very long time, insurance companies operate in the premise that policyholders' interests always come before the insurance company's interests.
segments.zh: 那就是保险业。这很重要，因为长期以来，保险公司运营的前提是保单持有人的利益始终优先于保险公司自身利益。
